learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Chose About200 against About35 and About20; locked it in.
observations.exploration: Catch50 found20 species; Catch500 found34; Catch5000 found40. New forest seed changed label from2 to3 while5000 catch still40. Opening reveal returned displayed seed to2 and original20/34/40 curve.
observations.reveal: Corrected toAbout35 and cited34 at500, under twice20 at50. Explained common species appear early then repeats dominate and rarer species accrue;5000 found all40. Said compare places at same catch size; made-up forest.
observations.visual: Actual1257 ×936 dark screenshot inspected. Green accumulation curve flattens at40 with20/50 and34/500 markers. Common-to-rare species strip fills. Full reveal legible.

prediction.reason: Plausible proportional versus saturating species options.

interaction.reason: Three catch sizes visibly show diminishing discoveries and full-species limit.

payoff.reason: Connects actual counts and flattening to common repeats and rare discoveries.

clarity.reason: Controls and labeled accumulation markers communicate tested sequence clearly.

transfer.reason: Concrete new comparison of two places with same-effort condition.
transfer.evidence: Compare two places only at same catch size.

surprise.reason: Tenfold catch produces less than twice species, contradicting200 prediction.

visualExplanation.reason: Curve plateau and species strip carry saturation mechanism.

playfulness.reason: Catch sizes and seed change offer reversible comparisons.

practicalValue.reason: Concrete equal-effort biodiversity comparison is central.
practicalValue.evidence: Two places require same catch size.

depth.reason: Sampling effort, rarity and finite total linked.

complexity.reason: Links uneven species frequency to diminishing discoveries and fair comparison.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Two linked relations: repeated common catches versus rare discovery; effort changes observed richness.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Low: clear preset catches and curve labels.
complexity.prerequisiteNovelty: moderate: species accumulation and unequal abundance.

whyCool: Increasing catch from500 to5000 adds only six species while the curve visibly flattens at40.
caveat: Reveal returned seed3 to seed2; evidence for alternate seed limited to5000 total, not its full curve.
effort: Approximately 3 minutes of actual browser review.
